title: Paired token and FNS phase range
description: Token and FNS median six-phase ranges divided by their own score IQRs for full-sequence and local-target paired comparisons on the 500-variant BRCA2 MAVE-derived MVE subset.
source_note: Values are the 500-variant rows from the experiment's paired FNS-token comparison. A dashed horizontal reference marks the predeclared 0.10 auxiliary threshold; paired differences and confidence intervals remain external.
qa_note: Value labels are raised from the renderer's 17px default to 20px after rendering so they remain legible in the 600px stress preview.
